description: transition_domain runs after a redirect is resolved, but records_success on the target domain before the redirected request has been issued. This inflates circuit-breaker success counts on domains that haven't actually responded successfully. Either (a) move the record_success call to after perform_follow_redirect returns, or (b) rename the method to reflect what it actually does (circuit-preflight + bookkeeping on transition). Blocked by c1h.3 (redirect extraction).
title: Stop recording success on target before contact (transition_domain)
